hints.title: Feasibility for Fixed Maximum Gap
hints.text: For a fixed maximum allowed gap distance, the number of additional stations needed between two stations is directly calculable.

hints.title: Segment Station Formula
hints.text: If gap is delta, the required stations count is floor(delta / d).

hints.title: Continuous Range Bisection
hints.text: Bisection over continuous distance range from 0 to the maximum possible interval allows locating the optimal maximum distance within numerical tolerance.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Binary search on the continuous answer range with 80 bisection steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily inserting stations one-by-one into a priority queue takes O(k * log N) time, which times out when k is up to 10^7.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) by evaluating feasibility in place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use monotonic feasibility predicate with fixed floating-point iteration count to avoid precision pitfalls.
